verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no capability for users to schedule recurring jobs or workflows, such as cron-style schedules, recurring exports or timed workflow runs. Exports are one-off requests with a start and end date, and batch processing is a one-off high-volume API. Per-customer ongoing monitoring is an adjacent automatic re-screening feature, not a user-defined recurring schedule, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
